DOC-DERIVED FIXTURE - NOT CAPTURED FROM A DEVICE
================================================

A reconstruction of an ERS/BOSS 8.x `show vlan` shape, written to pin one
behaviour: a VLAN TYPE keyword this build has never seen must not make the
whole VLAN disappear from the report.

The type name used here ('Voice') is illustrative. What matters is that it is
NOT in ers_parsers._VLAN_TYPES. Replace with a real capture when available.
